description: Renames one session on the agenda of an event the person organizes; `title` is the new name. Quiet unless `notify` is true. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm` returns a PREVIEW with a `changeId`, the before and after, how many pass holders would be notified and the notice, and changes nothing; read it back, and only when they say yes call again with `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. Name the session by `sessionId` or title; on AMBIGUOUS or NO_SUCH_SESSION read the candidates back and ask. Only the organizer of the event can change it; anybody else is refused, read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

at.description: Optional current start ("10:30 AM"), for sessions sharing a title.

confirm.description: Leave out for the preview; after the organizer says yes, true with the changeId.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

sessionId.description: The session id as the agenda gave it.

sessionTitle.description: Or the session title, when there is no sessionId.

name: event_session_rename
title: Rename a session (organizers only)
